segments.name: Pharmaceutical research and development
segments.description: An oncology-focused biotechnology company developing pharmaceutical drug candidates, principally Paxalisib, for patients with brain cancer and other oncology indications.
segments.evidence: The Consolidated Entity operates in the pharmaceutical research and development business.

revenueModel.text: Licensees and collaborators pay upfront license fees, development milestones and royalties for rights to the company's intellectual property.
revenueModel.evidence: The terms of the license include standard provisions for an upfront license fee and development milestones related to the initiation of Phase 1, Phase 2 trial, first Phase 3 trial, first product approval.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold all intellectual property and trademark rights to Cantrixil.
changes.evidence: Other sundry income represents the sale of all intellectual property and trademark rights to Cantrixil for US$ 1 million (A$ 1.6 million).

changes.text: In 2025 the company deprioritised a development program, with no further development activities planned for it.
changes.evidence: As a result, the EVT-801 program has been deprioritised and no further development activities are planned.
